en.i1t: Four sessions, 39,093 kg on three lifting days
en.i1: Four sessions, 5h 04m, 39,093 kg, 2,665 active kcal — against five sessions and 39,240 kg the week before. Thursday’s hack squat day is the heaviest piece: 82 minutes, 19 sets, 200 reps, 16,185 kg, avg HR 116, max 154, 687 active kcal. Tuesday’s deadlift day ran 76 minutes, 18 sets, 246 reps, 11,388 kg, avg HR 123, max 155, 712 active kcal. Saturday’s front squat day added 11,520 kg over 84 minutes for 686 kcal. The one pool swim covered 2,250 m in 62 minutes.
en.i2: Saturday’s front squat repeated Sep 5 exactly — 80 kg for 10 reps on all three working sets, 21 sets, 240 reps, 11,520 kg — the third session in a row anchored to 80 kg. It took 84 minutes against 81 on Sep 5, and avg HR came in at 116 against 111, with max 158 on both days: the same work at a slightly higher cardiac cost. Active burn was 686 kcal against 604. Zagreb air ran 11.8–22.3 °C.
en.i3t: Swim Sep 11: 2,250 m at 2:32 per 100 m
en.i3: Friday’s pool swim covered 2,250 m in 62 minutes as 500 + 8×200 + 100, averaging 2:32 per 100 m — six seconds off the 2:26 held on Aug 24 over the identical set. Avg HR 115 against 131 on Aug 24 and max 148 against 157: the pace came down with the effort, not against it. 580 active kcal, 25 strokes per minute over 90 lengths. Zagreb air ran 12.9–17.3 °C.
en.i4: Last night scored 87 on 7h 24m — 3 minutes over the 7h 21m seven-night average and above the 28-day baseline of 7.1 h. HRV held at 45, one above the seven-night mean of 44 and 2.2 above the 28-day baseline of 42.8. RHR rose to 52, level with the seven-night mean and 1.2 under the 28-day baseline of 53.2. Eight minutes awake, the least of the seven; deep sleep 58 minutes, also the least. Readiness computes to 88.
en.rec: Tonnage over the last seven days is 39,093 kg across three lifting days, against 39,240 kg the week before, with the 28-day chronic load at 34,663 kg a week — an ACWR of 1.13. Nothing flags: every top set held or eased — deadlift 120 kg × 10, hack squat 170 kg × 12, front squat 80 kg × 10 — and RHR at 52 sits 1.2 under its 28-day baseline of 53.2. Next session: pool swim, 2,200 m as 10 × 100 + 10 × 50 at 2:16–2:18 per 100 m, avg HR ≤ 125 — Friday’s swim was the 500 + 8 × 200, and the Aug 31 10 × 100 set held 2:16 at HR 121. Carbohydrate is the lever: a swim day carries the 2,200 kcal training-day target with 212 g of carbohydrate, and the three logged days on record landed 132–156 g. Put 60 g in the two hours before the pool.

hr.i1t: Četiri treninga, 39.093 kg u tri dana dizanja
hr.i1: Četiri treninga, 5h 04m, 39.093 kg, 2.665 aktivnih kcal — naspram pet treninga i 39.240 kg tjedan prije. Četvrtkov dan hack čučnja najteži je komad: 82 minute, 19 serija, 200 ponavljanja, 16.185 kg, prosj. HR 116, max 154, 687 aktivnih kcal. Utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja trajao je 76 minuta, 18 serija, 246 ponavljanja, 11.388 kg, prosj. HR 123, max 155, 712 aktivnih kcal. Subotnji prednji čučanj dodao je 11.520 kg kroz 84 minute za 686 kcal. Jedno plivanje u bazenu prešlo je 2.250 m u 62 minute.
hr.i2: Subotnji prednji čučanj ponovio je 5.9. do znamenke — 80 kg za 10 ponavljanja u sve tri radne serije, 21 serija, 240 ponavljanja, 11.520 kg — treći trening zaredom usidren na 80 kg. Trajao je 84 minute naspram 81 od 5.9., a prosj. HR bio je 116 naspram 111, uz max 158 oba dana: isti posao uz nešto veću srčanu cijenu. Aktivna potrošnja bila je 686 kcal naspram 604. Zrak u Zagrebu bio je 11,8–22,3 °C.
hr.i3: Petkovo plivanje u bazenu prešlo je 2.250 m u 62 minute kao 500 + 8×200 + 100, prosječno 2:32 na 100 m — šest sekundi iza 2:26 od 24.8. na istoj seriji. Prosj. HR 115 naspram 131 od 24.8. i max 148 naspram 157: tempo je pao zajedno s naporom, a ne protiv njega. 580 aktivnih kcal, 25 zaveslaja u minuti kroz 90 dužina. Zrak u Zagrebu bio je 12,9–17,3 °C.
hr.i4: Sinoć je ocjena bila 87 uz 7h 24m — 3 minute iznad sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 7h 21m i iznad 28-dnevne osnove od 7,1 h. HRV je ostao na 45, jedan iznad sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 44 i 2,2 iznad 28-dnevne osnove od 42,8. RHR je porastao na 52, izjednačeno sa sedmodnevnim prosjekom i 1,2 ispod 28-dnevne osnove od 53,2. Osam minuta budnosti, najmanje od sedam; duboki san 58 minuta, također najmanje. Spremnost se računa na 88.
hr.rec: Tonaža u zadnjih sedam dana iznosi 39.093 kg kroz tri dana dizanja, naspram 39.240 kg tjedan prije, a 28-dnevno kronično opterećenje je 34.663 kg tjedno — ACWR 1,13. Nema zastavice: svaka vršna serija se zadržala ili olakšala — mrtvo dizanje 120 kg × 10, hack čučanj 170 kg × 12, prednji čučanj 80 kg × 10 — a RHR na 52 stoji 1,2 ispod svoje 28-dnevne osnove od 53,2. Sljedeći trening: plivanje u bazenu, 2.200 m kao 10 × 100 + 10 × 50 uz 2:16–2:18 na 100 m, prosj. HR ≤ 125 — petkovo plivanje bilo je 500 + 8 × 200, a serija 10 × 100 od 31.8. držala je 2:16 uz HR 121. Poluga su ugljikohidrati: dan plivanja nosi cilj trening-dana od 2.200 kcal s 212 g ugljikohidrata, a tri zabilježena dana dosad bila su na 132–156 g. Unesi 60 g u dva sata prije bazena.
